title: Test the unchanged restart barrier when no named root is bound
outcome: Cover the case where a complete source declaration matches a later restart report but the evaluation was recorded with no named root.
acceptance: Record an evaluation with a complete declared SourceId and no named root. Account an exact same-source assumed_missing_baseline report after its cut and observe the UnadmittedChange stale reason. Cover the named-root condition directly rather than relying on a separate rebinding refusal.
